claims.statement: Organization profile can include description,location,website and email; these are optional presentation fields, not verified ownership/contact truth or required publication of personal data.
Pinned important repositories and README orient visitors; selected presentation does not establish complete organization inventory, architectural ownership or adopted policy.

FPT branch refers organizations using Enterprise Cloud to domain verification; GHEC/GHES branches describe domain verification directly. Parent FPT scope alone does not establish free-plan entitlement.
Verified badge indicates source-described domain identity confirmation, not repository access, security posture, accepted engineering controls or per-file rights clearance.

Customization/domain verification procedures are linked separately; this guide does not define operator permissions, exact verification steps, member/public variant or runtime receipt. Screenshot/aliases cannot substitute actual profile observation.
